This matters because it is the only route that does not depend on the September 2025 base being representative of the current China-collapse regime.
directions.data_to_find: JNTO monthly preliminary totals for September 2023, September 2024 (2,872,200 already known), September 2025 (3,266,800 already known), and August 2023-2025, to compute the September/August ratio series.

directions.hypothesis: The largest uncertainty is the September 2026 year-on-year change, which hinges on whether the China collapse (-59% in August) persists or deepens. directions.data_to_find: September 2026 China-Japan and total international seat capacity (OAG or airport authority), Narita/Haneda/Kansai September 2026 passenger statistics, and any JNTO or MOJ September 2026 entry-record commentary published before 2026-10-16.

directions.hypothesis: A component-sum route (d7) would be unlocked by September 2026 market-level arrivals or their year-on-year changes for Korea, Taiwan, China, Hong Kong and the US. Because China is the dominant swing factor, a September 2026 China figure (or a credible September China booking/capacity proxy) would materially narrow the estimate.
directions.data_to_find: September 2026 arrivals or year-on-year changes by source market from JNTO, or September 2026 China-Japan flight/seat schedules and Chinese outbound booking data.

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
